Lazy key tree over the cache-browser tree endpoint, with a server-side substring search that swaps the tree for a flat result list while active. (The tree's own toolbar filter still narrows already-loaded nodes.)

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/cache-browser/CacheTree.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { CacheTree } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/data";
```
